resources.string: Not selected — choose before installing or updating an extension

%1$s
%2$s
Shizuku must be installed and running. Miyorare Beta needs Shizuku permission.
%3$s
%1$s\n%2$s\nUses Android’s normal package installer. No Shizuku required.
%1$s\n%2$s\nNo installer popup and no Shizuku. The extension is stored only inside Miyorare.
⚠ Shizuku running — Miyorare permission not granted
Tap to choose before Update All
The selected installation method requires Shizuku. Make sure Shizuku is running and Miyorare Beta has permission.\n\n%1$s
System Installer needs Android confirmation for APK updates, so background APK auto-install is unavailable. Update notifications can still alert you.
Silent background APK updates work when Auto Update Extensions is enabled and Shizuku remains running with permission granted.
Private/Sandbox APK updates can run internally when Auto Update Extensions is enabled. They do not require Shizuku.
Shizuku did not respond in time. This is usually temporary. Try Update again. If it happens repeatedly, open Shizuku, make sure it is running and Miyorare still has permission, then try again.
Miyorare could not connect to the Shizuku installer service. Open Shizuku and confirm it is running with Miyorare permission, then try Update again.
Android took too long to finish installing the extension. Try Update again. If it keeps happening, restart Shizuku or use System Installer for this extension.
Android blocked the extension installation. Check device security or install restrictions, then try again. You can also switch to System Installer to see Android’s confirmation screen.
The extension installation was interrupted or cancelled. Try Update again. If you cancelled an Android prompt, accept it on the next attempt.
Android rejected the downloaded APK as invalid. Refresh the extension list and try Update again. If it repeats, check or change the extension repository.

The extension conflicts with an already installed package, usually because the signature or provider is different. Remove or migrate the old extension, then install again. If unsure, try System Installer to see Android’s detailed warning.
There is not enough usable storage to install the extension. Free some device storage, then try Update again.
This extension version is not compatible with your device or Android version. Try another version/repository or use a compatible extension.
Android reported: %1$s\n\nTry Update again. If it fails repeatedly, make sure Shizuku is running with permission or switch to System Installer to get Android’s detailed installer message.
